config.title: Attention Is All You Need
config.author: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin

must_include_phrases: Recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory [13] and gated recurrent [7] neural networks in particular, have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems
The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions
We call our particular attention 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'
must_exclude_phrases: Provided proper attribution is provided, Google hereby grants permission to reproduce the tables and figures in this paper
notes: The famous 'Attention Is All You Need' paper (Vaswani et al., NeurIPS 2017), defining the Transformer architecture. Published with Google permission notice. Text density 1.0 (full embedded text layer). Standard two-column arXiv-style academic format. Estimated 530 paragraphs based on page sampling; ±20% tolerance applied. Contains 3 figures showing attention mechanisms and model performance. Primary focus on multi-head attention, encoder-decoder architecture, and applications to machine translation and parsing. Authors listed with Google Brain/Research affiliations and University of Toronto. Notes: Profile confirms this is the seminal NeurIPS 2017 paper.
